verdict.rationale: Sprinto's own docs say it manages SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS and others in one place with pre-mapped controls. That implies shared control infrastructure across frameworks, but no item explicitly says SOC 2 work automatically counts toward ISO 27001 or HIPAA, or that overlap is displayed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of cross-framework control and evidence mapping, automatic reuse of SOC 2 work for ISO 27001/HIPAA, a view showing framework overlap, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
